semantics.initialization: No specified power-up state; load supplies initial state
semantics.load: At each rising edge with load high, q becomes data sampled at that edge, overriding evolution
semantics.evolution: At each rising edge with load low, every cell simultaneously updates from the previous q: 0 or 1 neighbors -> dead; 2 -> previous cell; 3 -> alive; 4 through 8 -> dead
semantics.layout: Cell (row,col) is q[16*row+col]; q[15:0] is row 0
semantics.neighbors: Eight adjacent cells excluding self; both coordinates wrap modulo 16
semantics.between_edges: q remains stable; changing load or data alone does not change q

numeric.neighbor_count: exact unsigned integer 0 through 8, requiring 4 bits
numeric.arithmetic: No overflow, rounding, saturation or truncation; wrap applies only to row and column indexing

verification.oracle: Independent nested offset loops count eight modulo-wrapped neighbors and apply the original four rules
verification.directed: Synchronous load and priority, consecutive loads, empty/full grids, isolated cell, stable block, blinker, corner/edge wrap
verification.exhaustive_local: For each location, exercise all 512 assignments of central cell and its eight neighbors across representative interior/edge/corner locations
verification.random: Seeded random grid loads followed by multiple generations; compare all 256 output bits after each rising edge
verification.timing: Check stability before rising edges and use finite compile/simulation timeouts

specification_ambiguities: Power-up state before a synchronous load is unspecified; no initialization or reset is added
